derivation.bump: Every normalized radial bump lies below 4. Its physical X endpoint is below 16*X0Ipos < exp(5)*X0Ipos.
derivation.wait: lambda>h>0 makes Qsteep>0. Qb>(1/3)*(1/2)*4*2048>1, while 0<Qp<27*h/255<h<1. Thus log(Qb/Qp)/(1-h)>0.
derivation.final: Immediately after the pulse lies an interval of length Tf=128, followed by positive stage lengths. Thus Xplus<Xv*exp(128)<Xb.
derivation.sourceStep: sigma=exp(-1/s^2)/(exp(-1/s^2)+exp(-1/(1-s)^2)) on (0,1), with flat endpoint jets; integral sigma_prime=1.

inequalities: all endpoints are independent of eta

leadingExterior.derivation: I1Right/IposLeft=exp(-6), decayEnd<IposLeft and loopIRight/IposLeft=exp(15-60000T)<1. X>=Xplus gives log(X/Xp)>=13/lambda+1. For I1 derivative bumps, X/X0I1>=exp(5)>32, beyond every support ending at 13.5.

analyticStep.etaStrips: delta_n=delta/(8*256^n)>0; every previous strip is at least256*delta_n
analyticStep.auxiliaryAgreement: 0<=X<=Xa only, by the actual zero-datum system and induction; outside this interval the actual finalized-cutoff source is retained.

normStep.leading: The internally generated ordinary leading jet bound at the required finite derivative rectangle.
normStep.radial: At fixed n, r>=2 uses the original second-order equation and only smaller same-order radial derivatives; all lower-order derivatives are already constructed.
normStep.global: Finite actual eta-independent radial moments, the fixed continuous Ipos inverse, exact bump jets, average and regular V reconstruct every mixed jet.
normStep.finite: Only sums/products/positive inverses/exponentials/factorials and finite derivative recurrences occur. All positive source denominators are retained.

definition.logRecurrence: log c_n=max(log c_(n-1)+log2, max_(0<=m<=n) (n log2+log B_nm)/(n h))
definition.laterAdditionalOriginalClauses: Enlarging any c_n, while preserving the same monotone doubling recurrence, preserves every normalized estimate, potential identity, and tail below. Such an enlargement is not claimed to have been computed here.

cutoffStep.derivativeBudget: Each n selects all mixed norms with total derivative order<=n, including the extra stream cutoff derivative.
cutoffStep.smoothLocalFiniteness: c_n>=2^n. Every compact q interval bounded away from0 has only finitely many active terms and derivatives.
cutoffStep.normalizedTail: For each fixed m and all n>=max(2,m), every selected normalized derivative is<=2^-n*q^(n*h).

allOrderInduction.proofKind: Executable recurrence plus mathematical induction on the actual source order and ordinary radial derivative; finite source checks are regression witnesses, not a truncation proof.

chart.slowTimeDerivative: partial_T, with tau=Q*T; the physical normalized time operator is -epsilon*partial_T

FGDifference.derivatives: each ordinary slow derivative of total order<=2
FGDifference.comparison: actual order-zero chart fields at the same slow point

derivation.composition: D_iD_j f=sum a_ik*a_jl*f_kl + sum a_ik*(partial_k a_jl)*f_l. The executed row sums give A^2+A*B; no derivative of a chart Jacobian is omitted.
derivation.multipliers: Each ordinary profile derivative of each normalization factor is included by the full binomial Leibniz sum.
derivation.actualSequence: The finite block uses actual n=1 and n=2. The n>=3 tail uses the all-order diagonal inequality, so its first q power is at least3h.
derivation.leadingRadial: The actual complete U0 and its radial average generate V0/X. No zero radial background is assumed on Imean.

inactiveTail.proof: c_n>=2^(n-anchor)*c_anchor and q>=1/(16*c_anchor), so c_n*q>=1 for every n>=anchor+4. All cutoff derivatives vanish there.

plateau.proof: c_n<=c_anchor and q<=1/(2*c_anchor), so chi=1 and all positive cutoff derivatives=0 for every n<=anchor.

inactiveTail.proof: q>=2^(-ell-1) and c_n>=2^n imply c_n*q>=1 for every integer n>=ell+1. The complete smooth cutoff and all its derivatives vanish.
